name: 98008 · Bellevue, WA
findings: ZIP 98008 (Bellevue) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98008 (Bellevue) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98008 (Bellevue) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.
